keywords: Vitalik 不可区分混淆（iO）长文
EIP-7906 TXDIFF 按 EIP-2929 计价
summary: Vitalik 发布一篇约一万字的长文，梳理主流不可区分混淆（iO）协议背后的整棵技术树。weiihann 在 ethresear.ch 发表以太坊状态访问剖析，为休眠状态分离、状态过期等研究提供数据基础。forshtat 为 EIP-7906 的 TXDIFF 指定按 EIP-2929 规则计价并合并。当晚召开 ACDT #85。

items.title_en: ethresear.ch: The Price of Forgery, measuring Sybil resistance in dollars (a paper)
items.note_en: 15:53 (porobov), proposing "how many dollars it costs to break a proof of personhood method" as a shared metric.

items.title: ethresear.ch：以太坊状态访问剖析
items.note: 17:37（weiihann）。每笔交易都读写余额、nonce、代码和存储槽，随着链增长，越来越多状态长期无人触碰，因此有分离休眠状态、让休眠状态过期、创建新形式状态等提案；报告为这些研究提供实证数据。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: The Anatomy of Ethereum's State Access
items.note_en: 17:37 (weiihann). Every transaction reads and writes balances, nonces, code and storage slots; as the chain grows, more state goes untouched for a long time, which is why proposals look at separating dormant state, expiring it or creating new forms of state. The report provides empirical data for that research.

items.title_en: EIP-7906: TXDIFF priced by EIP-2929 rules, duplicate paragraph removed
items.note_en: (forshtat), submitted and merged: storage slot parameters use `COLD_SLOAD_COST`/`WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST`, and balance and codehash parameters use `COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS_COST`/`WARM_STORAGE_READ_COST`, replacing a flat placeholder cost.

the anatomy of Ethereum's state access
summary_en: Vitalik published a post of about ten thousand words covering the whole tech tree behind the main lineage of indistinguishability obfuscation (iO) protocols. weiihann published The Anatomy of Ethereum's State Access on ethresear.ch, giving an empirical base for research on separating or expiring dormant state. forshtat specified EIP-2929 based pricing for EIP-7906's TXDIFF, and it was merged. ACDT #85 was held in the evening.
